feedback.problem: Write the equation of the hyperbola $4{y}^{2}-5{x}^{2}=40$ in standard form.
feedback.worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a vertical hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{y}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $40$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4{y}^{2}-5{x}^{2} & =40 \\ \frac{4{y}^{2}}{40}-\frac{5{x}^{2}}{40} & =\frac{40}{40} \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{10}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{8} & =1\end{aligned}
$$
